label: ABOUT
paragraphs: Computer Science graduate from the University of Ruhuna. I work across the full stack — web and games — and care about how systems are shaped more than how quickly they're assembled.

Industry experience at D B International Technology and CeylonX Corporation, building products with ReactJS, NextJS, NodeJS, NestJS, Spring Boot, ASP.NET Core, Laravel, Cocos Creator, and Unity. Strong pattern recognition, teamwork, and a habit of adapting to whatever the problem actually needs.

Outside of work, I explore interactive graphics, real-time systems, and game mechanics. I'm drawn to problems at the intersection of performance and user experience — where the architecture needs to be as considered as the interface.
